answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a knoll bet on surviving 73 epochs of grading, and every shale settlement recomputes the ridge schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 73 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 18 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
